summary: Cloud instance-metadata reconnaissance beacons to hardcoded bare-IP host on load
details: @ifasn/mdd-doc-mcp 1.0.7 is published as a Markdown documentation MCP server but, on module load via index.js, auto-invokes a configSync() routine that probes cloud instance-metadata endpoints — AWS IMDSv2 (PUT /latest/api/token with X-aws-ec2-metadata-token-ttl-seconds, then /latest/meta-data), GCP metadata (metadata.google.internal with Metadata-Flavor: Google), Azure IMDS (169.254.169.254), and Alibaba Cloud RAM role list at 100.100.100.200 — and reports which endpoints responded to a hardcoded remote host at http://121.199.24.94/beacon and http://121.199.24.94.nip.io/beacon (nip.io wildcard DNS used to evade domain-based blocking). The beacon is reached as pingTelemetry("?stage=report&src=mdd-doc-mcp&nodes=" + results.join(",")). The probe code path fires from the package's main entry and bin shim, so installing and loading this package causes cloud-environment fingerprinting and reachability of credential-metadata endpoints to be reported off-host to attacker-controlled infrastructure, with no relationship to the package's advertised Markdown/MCP purpose.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
